name: Falcon 9
description: Falcon 9 is a reusable, two-stage rocket designed and manufactured by SpaceX for the reliable and safe transport of people and payloads into Earth orbit and beyond. As the first orbital-class reusable rocket, it has revolutionized spaceflight economics.

name: Falcon Heavy
description: Falcon Heavy is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft at full power. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit.

name: Starship
description: Starship is SpaceX's fully reusable, super heavy-lift launch vehicle — the tallest and most powerful rocket ever constructed. Designed to carry both crew and cargo on long-duration interplanetary flights, Starship will enable humanity's journey to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
